id.description: Stable dotted id, used in settings, logs and the CLI. Must match the file name.

safety.description: safe: pure cache. caution: loses something the user may want (cookies, history). advanced: experts only.

elevation.description: Needs the admin helper (Windows folders, other users).

detect.description: The rule only shows if one of these paths exists.

runningProcesses.description: Image names that hold these files open. If running, Scour warns and offers to skip.

handler.description: Built-in handler for locations a path can't describe. Targets may then be empty.

pattern.description: File-name glob (* and ?), matched against each file's name.

exclude.description: Full-path globs never touched, even inside a target. Start with an env var or *.

minAgeHours.description: Skip files newer than this, so active temp files survive.

rootedPath.description: Must start with an environment variable. May use {chromiumProfile}, {firefoxProfile} and * / ? in folder names.
